en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a well-tended square surrounded by 19th or early 20th century European buildings, with a small garden, pathways, and a fountain in the center. The area appears peaceful and elegant, suggesting it is a prominent public space. The text on the image side reads 'Gruss aus Bad Pyrmont.' and 'Altenauplatz.' The reverse side includes traditional postcard formatting, with 'Deutsche Reichspost. Postkarte.' at the top, address lines, and a stamp area, as well as a logo/marking for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
